CustomZones.Title: Custom Zones
CustomZones.NewZoneHint: Choose the zone it behaves like: it uses that zone's demand, and you then pick which of its buildings may grow.
CustomZones.Name: Name
CustomZones.BigHint: Install Building Icon Generator to see real pictures of every building.
CustomZones.LevelUpHint: When off, buildings in this zone keep the level they were born with, while other zones keep levelling up.
CustomZones.KeepDesignHint: On: a building levels up into its own design when that level is ticked; otherwise into another ticked building of the next level. Off: into any ticked building of the next level, at random, like the game.
CustomZones.NoBuildings: Nothing can grow yet: choose at least one building below.
CustomZones.GrowsInZone: This level grows in this zone
CustomZones.DemandNoHousing: No housing demand for this density right now: it will not grow until there is
CustomZones.DemandYesLong: The city needs more of it right now, so it can grow.
CustomZones.DemandNoLong: The city does not need more of it right now: it will not grow, even in this zone, until there is demand.
CustomZones.HelpCard: Click a card to add the building to this zone with all its levels (click again to remove it). To leave a level out, untick its number.
CustomZones.HelpLevels: The numbers 1-5 are its levels: click one to add or remove just that level. Like the game, buildings are born at level 1 and level up one by one; with "Skip levels" they are born at their lowest ticked level and jump over the unticked ones. Filled = in this zone, outlined = the one on the picture, dim = it does not exist.
CustomZones.HelpZoom: The magnifier shows it large, with every level, and lets you place one in the city.
CustomZones.HelpGoods: Under the name: its lot size (cells wide x deep), its height at the level shown and what it sells, makes or stores.
CustomZones.HelpDemand: In red with a warning: the city does not need more of it right now. A building only grows when there is demand for what it sells or makes, even when this zone allows it.
CustomZones.GrowthGrowing: Growing: the city is choosing buildings for its free lots
CustomZones.GrowthNoLots: No free lots right now: paint this zone along a road (or every lot is already built).
CustomZones.GrowthNothingFits: Its buildings do not fit the free gaps left. Normal when the zone is nearly full; if it is empty, add buildings of other sizes or paint deeper zones.
CustomZones.GrowthNoDemand: Its buildings fit, but the city has no demand for them right now.
CustomZones.GrowthLowScore: The city wants them, but not here yet: this spot scores too low for them (workers, education, services, land value, pollution or road access).
CustomZones.GrowthTypeNoDemand: The city has no demand for this type of zone right now (its demand bar is empty), so nothing of this type grows anywhere.
CustomZones.GrowableHint: Only buildings the city has demand for right now (the ones that can grow).
CustomZones.DeletePainted: Painted cells that will be unzoned:
CustomZones.DeleteCondemn: Like erasing zoning in the game, the buildings on them will be condemned.
CustomZones.DeleteNotPainted: This zone is not painted anywhere in this city.
CustomZones.IconDefault: The icon of the zone it behaves like
CustomZones.IconDesign: Design an icon of your own, in the style of the game's zone icons.
CustomZones.MissingWidthsHint: The game splits a zone along a road into lots 1 to 6+ cells wide. A lot only gets a building when the zone has one of exactly that width; add buildings of those widths if you want them built.
CustomZones.MissingWidthsText: No building of this zone fits lots this many cells wide, so they stay empty:
CustomZones.LevelSet: Turn it into a building of this level now (its own design when it has this level).
CustomZones.LevelNone: No building of this zone, lot size and goods fits at this level here (too few homes for the households living there, or too tall for this spot).
CustomZones.IconSaveHint: Keep this icon in your library: it stays there after the zone is deleted and can be used for any zone.
CustomZones.SavedIconsHint: Icons you saved from the designer. Click one to use it on this zone; it takes the zone colour. The cross in the corner removes it (click twice).
CustomZones.SelectedOnlyHint: Only the buildings already chosen for this zone.
CustomZones.ZoomReset: Whole building (0). Mouse wheel zooms where the pointer is, drag to move, double click to zoom in or out.
CustomZones.PlaceLevelHint: Place it in the city (Escape comes back here)
CustomZones.TypeInZone: In this zone: every building chosen for this zone, whatever its type.
CustomZones.SharedLevelLook: The game has no separate building for level {level} of this design: it looks like its level {below}.
CustomZones.SharedLevelTop: This design goes no higher than level {below}.
CustomZones.MoreIcons: Show all the game's zone icons
CustomZones.ShareZones: Import zones shared by others, or export all of yours
CustomZones.ExportAllHint: Save every zone to one file you can share.
CustomZones.ImportNone: No zone files yet. Export a zone, or put .json files shared by others in this folder:
CustomZones.ImportHint: Add the zones in this file as new zones. Buildings of assets you do not have are kept but never grow.
CustomZones.ExportFailed: Could not export (see the mod's log).
CustomZones.ExportZone: Export this zone to a file you can share (Exports folder of the mod).
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION[CustomZones.C: Growable buildings placed by hand (with the placement tool, Find It or similar) are kept while the zone under them stays the one they were placed on. When that zone changes, the usual rules apply. Off: they follow the zone rules from the start, like any other building.
Options.OPTION[CustomZones.CustomZones.M: Level buttons in the building panel
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION[CustomZones.C: Shows the "level up" and "choose level" buttons in the info panel of zoned buildings.
Opens the folder where exported zones are saved. Put zone files shared by others here to import them from the panel.
Removes every icon saved from the icon designer. Zones keep the icon they use.
Remove every saved icon? This cannot be undone.
CustomZones.StatsNotPainted: Not painted anywhere in this city yet.
CustomZones.StatsHint: In this city: painted cells, buildings standing on this zone, households in its homes and workers in its jobs.
CustomZones.GrowthLikeGameHint: New buildings are born at level 1 and level up one level at a time into a ticked building of the next level, like in the game.
CustomZones.WarnNoBirth: Nothing can be born: tick level 1 of some buildings, or choose "Skip levels" so they are born at their lowest ticked level.
CustomZones.WarnStopsHint: A building only levels up into a ticked building that fits its lot (of the next level, or with "Skip levels" its own next ticked level). Tick more levels or designs of these lot sizes to let them go higher.
CustomZones.SharedLevelOther: A building of this design that reaches level {level} becomes another building ticked for that level, like in the game.
CustomZones.GrowthSkipHint:
Each building keeps its own design: it is born at its lowest ticked level and levels up into its next ticked level, jumping over the unticked ones (never into another design). A skipped level still takes the time it takes in the game.
Mind the economy: a building born above level 1 asks that level's rent from the start, and its jobs want more educated workers, so it may struggle in a young or poor city.
CustomZones.KeepDesignSkipHint: Zones that skip levels always keep each building's own design.
CustomZones.SharedLevelJump: In a zone that skips levels, it goes from level {below} straight to its level {above}, taking the game's time for the levels in between.
CustomZones.AllLevelsHint: Every level of this building grows in this zone (A). Untick it to take them all away.
CustomZones.WarnLocked: of its buildings belong to a zone this city has not unlocked yet (milestones). Like in the game, they only grow once it is unlocked.
